{{Quote|I need a ''diversion.'' Broadcasting the ''tape'' you have should be an ''excellent'' one. Just plug in ''here''.|Master-Com|<ref name="MSW23" />}}
A '''master relay terminal''' was a terminal which could override all communications systems, such as [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreens]], throughout a connected network. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] used [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel's]] master relay terminal to broadcast proof of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] treachery on all communicator screens throughout the Wheel, sparking a riot.<ref name="MSW23" />
